# Crews Local Services

> Tree service in Battle Creek, MI. Tree removal, tree trimming, stump grinding and
> storm damage cleanup for homeowners in Battle Creek and the surrounding towns.
> Free on-site estimates. Phone: (231) 729-1915

## Services

- [Tree Removal](https://TODO.example.com/tree-removal): Whole trees taken down, including tight spots near wires, fences and roofs.
- [Tree Trimming](https://TODO.example.com/tree-trimming): Deadwood, low limbs and branches over the roof or driveway cut back before they come down on their own.
- [Stump Grinding](https://TODO.example.com/stump-grinding): The leftover stump ground below grade so you can mow straight over it.
- [Storm Damage Cleanup](https://TODO.example.com/storm-damage-cleanup): Trees and limbs down after a storm cut up and cleared out of the way.

## Notes

- Estimates are free, done in person, and carry no obligation.
- Prices are not published: they depend on the size of the tree, what is beneath
  it, access for equipment, and proximity to wires or structures.
- For a downed power line or a tree contacting a line, the electric utility must
  make it safe first.
